methods.notes: Passively read the service-data value associated with 0xFDCD. Do not connect or write to discover support. Check the model byte and every TLV length before decoding. Unknown model and TLV IDs are skipped without discarding valid neighboring values.

identification.notes: Match service DATA under 16-bit UUID 0xFDCD, not a connectable GATT service. The second service-data byte selects the model using protocol_details.device_types; unknown IDs remain unknown.

device.name: Qingping / ClearGrass Sensors (stock BLE broadcasts)
device.notes:
A receive-only decoder for the stock Qingping/ClearGrass service-data broadcasts under 0xFDCD. No connection, pairing, account, hub or cloud is needed for current readings. This is NOT the PVVX/custom 0x181A format, MiBeacon, BTHome, a LoRaWAN transport, or a GATT configuration API.
The packet starts with an flags/type header and a six-byte address-like field, followed by type-length-value records. Different models emit different subsets. Update only fields present in a packet and retain the previous value for fields it omits. In particular, TLV 0x18 is a static capability bitmap, NOT CO2; only TLV 0x13 carries CO2. On event packets (header bit 6), TLV 0x08 updates motion but its illuminance bytes are not a valid light reading.
Broadcasts have no sender authentication, encryption, signature or replay protection in the documented parser. Validate lengths and do not use one unauthenticated reading as the sole input to a medical alarm, safety interlock or high-confidence occupancy decision.

openness.notes: Qingping does not publish this stock service-data layout here. The maintained open parser and its fixtures are the protocol evidence.

pairing.notes: Nothing pairs for passive reception. The frames themselves provide no pairing proof or sender authentication. This does not rule out bonding on a separate GATT history or configuration surface not covered here.

credentials.notes: No credential is needed for stock advertisements. Optional app/gateway accounts are outside this spec.

factory_reset.description: Passive reception creates no pairing state to clear. A model-specific reset is a destructive owner operation in the vendor app or device UI, not part of this receive-only protocol.
factory_reset.effect: No family-wide reset procedure is established. The archived CGG1 guide says its factory reset erases local history and releases app pairing; do not generalize that procedure or its effects to the other models.

methods.description: Scan for stock 0xFDCD service data, select the model from byte 1, then walk complete TLVs and update only the values they carry.

steps.action: Passively scan for service data under 0000fdcd-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb.
Require at least the eight-byte header, accept only a known device-type byte, and walk each complete type-length-value record.
steps.expect: Known measurements update; omitted fields retain their previous values and malformed TLVs are skipped.

setup.notes: No setup is needed for the passive subset. Historical apps, optional Bluetooth gateways, display settings and history synchronization are separate surfaces and are not required to receive these broadcasts.

rejoin.notes: No network membership or passive-client bond; resume scanning.

testing.notes: Not scanned or driven against hardware by this project. The envelope, model IDs and TLV decodes come from qingping-ble 1.3.0 and its anonymized fixtures. Its 39 tests passed upstream; the independent tests shipped with this spec check the documented decoding, not physical compatibility.

FDCD_Service_Data.description: One stock Qingping service-data VALUE, excluding the two-byte 0xFDCD UUID. All offsets below start at the first value byte. TLVs begin at offset 8 and repeat as type, length, payload until the value ends.

fields.description: Flags byte. Bit 6 (0x40) marks an event packet; other bits are not fully established.
fields.name: header

fields.description: One-byte model ID; see protocol_details.device_types. Unknown IDs are not guessed.
fields.name: device_type

fields.description: Six bytes. The source parser does not use them to prove identity or select a model; redact them in published captures.
fields.name: address_like

fields.description: Type byte, one-byte payload length, then exactly that many payload bytes. Subsequent TLVs use the same envelope.
fields.name: first_tlv

parse_rules: Require the complete eight-byte header before walking TLVs. A packet with no TLV payload carries no new measurement.
At offset 8, read type and length, then require the whole declared payload to fit. Skip a truncated TLV rather than decoding a partial value.
Skip unknown TLV IDs and continue with the next complete record. Do not let an unknown record discard valid known measurements.
If header & 0x40 is nonzero, this is an event packet: TLV 0x08 may update motion, but do not update illuminance from that TLV.
All multibyte numbers in protocol_details.tlvs are little-endian. Apply the declared scale once. Preserve missing values as unavailable, never zero.

Worked CGDK2-shaped example: 08 10 00 00 00 00 00 00 01 04 1c 01 af 02 02 01 64 = model 0x10, temperature 28.4 C, humidity 68.7 percent, battery 100 percent. The six zero bytes are a placeholder address-like field.

FDCD_TLVs.description: Measurement payloads carried by FDCD_Service_Data. The authoritative machine-readable lengths, field offsets, types, scales and special cases are in protocol_details.tlvs. A packet may contain any subset.

fields.description: TLV 0x01: int16 LE temperature x 0.1 C, then uint16 LE relative humidity x 0.1 percent.
fields.name: temperature_humidity

fields.description: TLV 0x02: one byte percent. 0xff means externally powered and is displayed as 100, not measured battery capacity.
fields.name: battery

fields.description: TLV 0x04: values 0 and 2 mean door/open true; only 2 also means left-open/problem true.
fields.name: door

fields.description: TLV 0x08: one motion byte followed by low uint16 and high uint8 illuminance. Ignore the light bytes on event packets.
fields.name: motion_illuminance_24

fields.description: TLV 0x12: uint16 LE PM2.5 and uint16 LE PM10, both ug/m3.
fields.name: particulates

fields.description: TLV 0x13: uint16 LE ppm. This is the only CO2 measurement TLV; 0x18 is a capability bitmap.
fields.name: co2

fields.description: TLV 0x15: uint16 LE unitless VOC index. Do not convert it to a concentration or assert a precise range.
fields.name: voc_index

fields.description: TLV 0x18: two-byte static hardware capability bitmap, not a sensor output.
fields.name: capability_bitmap

fields.description: TLV 0x19: one-byte sound pressure in dB.
fields.name: sound_pressure

fields.description: TLV 0x0f: one-byte packet identifier, metadata rather than a measurement.
fields.name: packet_id

parse_rules: Select the decoder by TLV ID and require the exact declared payload length before reading fields.
For TLV 0x08 in a non-event packet, illuminance = uint16_le(payload[1:3]) + (payload[3] << 16).
Retain the last value when a later packet omits a field or an event packet invalidates only the illuminance portion of TLV 0x08.

fields.name: voc_index
fields.range: unresolved; source comments disagree on 0-500 versus 1-500

protocol_details.transport: passive BLE service data; no GATT connection

update_policy.event_tlv_08: update motion only; retain previous illuminance
update_policy.unknown_tlvs: skip without discarding valid known TLVs

remaining_unknowns: No physical advertisements were captured by this project; all byte-level facts are source/fixture-derived and untested here.
The remaining header bits, and whether individual models add event variants beyond the documented bit-6 rule.
The VOC index range: upstream comments say 0-500 while a constant says 1-500. Keep it unitless and unbounded until resolved.
Home Assistant advertises fewer models than the parser recognizes. Parser support is not proof of physical support for CGDK2, CGR1PC or CGP23W Pro S.
History, configuration, alarms, naming, display content and firmware update use separate surfaces not documented here.
